experimental_design: incorporation of 13C615N2-labeled elafin into bacterial proteins across three Lactobacillus species
Using synthetized elafin fragments containing 13C615N2-labeled lysines, we analyzed whether these latter were found in the amino acid sequence of some bacterial proteins.
